name: Retail can place a new order
description: Walks the four-step new order wizard to completion and confirms an order id in the B-format is issued.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /Account/Login and sign in as retail@nexus.example with the password Nexus@2026
Navigate to /Retail/NewOrder. The form is a four step wizard: Service, Customer, Installation, Account
On step 1, select a connection type radio, then select a plan radio, then select a billing cycle radio. Click the button labelled Next
On step 2, fill Full Name with E2E Test Customer, Mobile Number with 03001234567 and CNIC with 42101-1234567-1. Click Next
On step 3, fill Installation Address with 12 Test Street Lahore, choose the first option in the City dropdown, and fill Existing Landline with 021-1234567. Click Next
On step 4, fill Password and Confirm Password both with Test@1234, and tick the terms checkbox
Click the submit button at the end of step 4 and wait for the page to navigate

Assert the browser has left /Retail/NewOrder and an order id matching the format B followed by ten digits is displayed on the resulting page. If the page is still the wizard with validation errors, this test must fail.
